content_html:
An autonomous, multi-tenant, AI-native software factory

Most AI tools tell you what they did. Eva writes it down first.

Every question you ask, every answer that comes back, every retry, and every token counted is appended to a file on your disk as it happens. What you see on screen is read back out of that file. If Eva shows you an answer, the file already had it. There is no second version of events.

That sounds like a small thing. It is the whole design.

What it looks like

Notice cost unreported in the status line. Neither Anthropic nor OpenAI returns a dollar figure with a response. So Eva says so, rather than multiplying tokens by a price it looked up somewhere. A number you can argue with a bill about has to come from the bill.

Note

Eva is early. Today it is a good terminal chat client with a very carefully built foundation. It can read your question and answer it. It cannot read your files, run your tests, or touch your shell — there are no tools yet.

Where this is going

Eva is being built toward a control plane for coding agents. Work arrives as a spec with acceptance criteria a machine can check. Several harnesses race the same spec in isolated environments. A verifier Eva owns decides what actually passed, and the whole race is scored from the same record everything else is scored from.

The reason for building the foundation this carefully first is the ladder in docs/explanation/the-ladder.md: ten rungs from a model to a company, climbed in order. Every step adds the one thing the rung below it cannot do, so every step you don't take is a way this fails.

Rung What breaks without it
Model —
Workflow Control flow is handed to the model before the model can hold it
Agent Nothing adapts. Every path has to be written in advance
Environment + verifier Nothing tells the agent it is wrong, so it never converges
Harness A run has no bounds — no budget, no policy, no tools it may use
Scheduler + spec format More agents is not a factory. A factory needs a queue and a spec
Software factory Work stays one at a time
Learning loop + economics No evals, and no cost per merged change
Intent + authority Nobody owns what was decided, and nobody answers for it
Autonomous company —

Nineteen stages, each with an exit test it can fail. One of them is built. The plan is a draft; the stage that shipped is not.

Install

The quickest way in, on macOS or Linux:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/missingstudio/eva/main/scripts/install.sh | sh

It reads your platform, downloads the matching archive, and checks it against the release's published checksums before installing anything — a checksum that does not match installs nothing and prints both figures. If you would rather not pipe a URL into a shell, it is scripts/install.sh in this repository; read it, then run it.

With the Go toolchain instead:

go install github.com/missingstudio/eva/cmd/eva@latest

Build it yourself

You need Go 1.26 or newer, and nothing else.

git clone git@github.com:missingstudio/eva.git
cd eva
go build -o eva ./cmd/eva

That produces a single binary in the current directory. Put it on your PATH if you want it everywhere. eva version says which build you are talking to.

You can also install the newest commit directly, which needs no release:

go install github.com/missingstudio/eva/cmd/eva@main

Go resolves main to a pseudo-version carrying the commit, so eva version still reports something exact. It has passed CI and nothing else — expect a broken day now and then.

To try a fix before it is released, the install script takes a channel:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/missingstudio/eva/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --channel next

Every path, plus how to verify a download's signature and provenance, is written up in how-to/install-eva.md.

Connect a model

Eva talks to Anthropic and OpenAI. Pick one.

With an API key

export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
./eva

That's the whole setup. Anthropic is the default, so nothing needs configuring.

For OpenAI, create a settings file and name the provider:

./eva init                       # writes ~/.eva/config.toml
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
[provider]
name = "openai"

One line is enough. The model and the key variable follow the provider you picked, so you get gpt-5.6-terra reading OPENAI_API_KEY without saying either out loud.

With a ChatGPT or Codex subscription

If you pay OpenAI monthly, you can use that instead of an API key:

./eva login

It prints a URL and a short code, you approve it in a browser, and the credential is saved to ~/.eva/auth.json. Then set the mode in ~/.eva/config.toml:

[provider]
name = "openai"
auth = "subscription"

Check what Eva will actually use at any time:

./eva auth status
provider: openai
auth:     subscription
store:    /Users/you/.eva/auth.json
login:    account acct_1a2b, valid until Mon, 11 Aug 2026 09:14:00 IST

Important

auth decides, and nothing overrides it. If it says subscription, an exported OPENAI_API_KEY is ignored, and eva auth status will tell you so rather than quietly using it. Most tools try the environment first, which is how people bill the wrong account for a month without noticing. (why)

Your key is never written to a settings file. Eva reads it from the environment, or gets it when you log in. It never appears in the history file, a log, or anything sent to a model.

Using Eva

Chatting

Run eva with no arguments and type. Answers stream in as they arrive.

Key What it does
enter Send
shift+enter or alt+enter New line without sending
ctrl+c Stop the answer in progress, keep what you typed
ctrl+d Quit
tab Finish a slash command
shift+↑ ↓, pgup pgdn Scroll back
ctrl+home / ctrl+end Jump to the top / back to live

Interrupting is safe. The conversation stays usable and the history file records that you stopped it.

Slash commands

Type / at the start of a line. These are handled locally and never reach a model, so they cost nothing.

Command What it does
/help List the commands
/cost What this conversation has cost so far
/clear Start a fresh conversation
/model Show which model is answering
/model gpt-5.6-terra Switch models, keeping the conversation
/login Explains that logging in happens outside the chat

/model swaps the model mid-conversation without dropping context, so the next answer still knows what you talked about. Eva doesn't keep a list of valid model names, because a list compiled last month would reject a model released last week. If the provider doesn't recognise the name, that answer fails and tells you.

/clear starts a new conversation rather than deleting messages from the current one. Your old messages are still in the history file either way. (why)

From a script

eva -p answers one question, prints it to stdout, and exits.

eva -p "explain this error" > answer.md || echo "that failed"

It exits non-zero when the answer failed, and writes the reason to stderr. That makes it safe to use in a pipeline: stdout is the answer and nothing else.

When something fails

› what is this?

No response — the credential was refused
provider.auth is "api_key", so what anthropic refused is the key in
$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

Two lines, both true. The first names the kind of failure, in Eva's own words rather than the vendor's error document. The second appears only when Eva checked something about your machine, and only when that fact leaves exactly one next step. A missing login says run eva login because that is certainly the fix. A refused key says which key was sent and stops, because revoked, wrong organisation, and suspended account all look identical from here. Sending you to fix something that was never broken costs you every later hint that would have been right. (why)

Everything you can type

Command What it does
eva Open the chat
eva -p "<question>" Answer once, print to stdout, exit
eva init Write a starter settings file
eva login Sign in to a subscription
eva auth status Show how Eva will authenticate
eva help Show this list

Two flags, and that's deliberate: --config <path> picks a settings file, -p <question> asks one question. Everything else is a setting, because settings are reviewable and flags are not.

Environment variable What it's for
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY Your Anthropic key
OPENAI_API_KEY Your OpenAI key
EVA_CONFIG A different settings file (default ~/.eva/config.toml)
EVA_HOME A different home for Eva's files (default ~/.eva)

Settings

eva init writes ~/.eva/config.toml with every option present but commented out, and a note beside each saying what happens without it. Nothing is chosen for you. Uncomment a line to change it.

Here is what Eva does with none of it written down:

model = "claude-sonnet-4-5"     # follows the provider if you leave it out

[provider]
name        = "anthropic"       # anthropic or openai
auth        = "api_key"         # api_key or subscription
api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
base_url    = ""                # a proxy, gateway, or local server
max_tokens  = 0                 # 0 lets the provider decide

[trace]
path = "~/.eva/trace.jsonl"     # where the history goes
kind = "jsonl"                  # which writer keeps it

[identity]
tenant     = "local"
actor      = "local"
actor_kind = "human"            # human, agent, or system

Colours, glyphs, spacing, and key bindings live under [theme] and [keymap.bind], and the starter file lists those too. Set none of them and Eva looks exactly as it did before any of it was configurable. Colours follow your terminal's background and what it can display, so it fits in without being told.

Settings are read from four places, each overriding the one before: built-in defaults, your file, the project's file, then --config. Eva works fine with none of them.

A typo is an error, not a shrug. Write modl = "..." and Eva refuses to start and names the key. A settings file that silently ignores what you wrote is worse than one that won't load.

Project settings

A repo can carry .eva/config.toml, found by walking up from wherever you are. Handy for sharing a team's look:

[theme.colors]
person = "#7AA6DC"

[theme.symbols]
prompt = "› "

[keymap.bind]
follow = ["ctrl+g"]

Warning

A repo can change how Eva looks, never what it does. You clone a repo from the internet, and Eva reads that file before your first question, in a process holding your API key. So the list of what it may set is a short allow-list: appearance and key bindings. It cannot pick the model provider, point traffic at another server, rename the variable your key is read from, or move your history file. Anything else in that file is refused by name. (why)

Glossary

Eva is strict about naming, because the same concept under three names is how a codebase rots. Five of them show up in the docs and the code:

Word Plain English
Session One conversation. Survives a crash. What resume and rewind will act on.
Run One question and its answer. A conversation has many.
Turn One round trip to the model. A single Run may need several once tools exist.
Trace The history file. The single source of truth for what happened.
Provider A model behind one interface: Anthropic, OpenAI, whatever comes next.

The full list is CONTEXT.md, including the words that were tried and retired.

How Eva is built

One Go module. Data flows one way, and the compiler enforces it.

   you type                                     you read
      │                                            ▲
      ▼                                            │
   ┌──────┐    ┌──────┐    ┌───────────┐        ┌────────┐
   │ tui  │───▶│ loop │───▶│ providers │        │ render │
   └──────┘    └──┬───┘    └───────────┘        └───▲────┘
                  │                                 │
                  ▼          committed first        │
              ┌───────┐  ───────────────────────────┘
              │ trace │      then shown
              └───────┘

The important part is the bottom. Nothing reaches your screen that didn't go through the file first. The rendering layer physically cannot talk to a model, a conversation, or the history file. It takes records and returns strings, and that's all it's allowed to import.

Package What lives there
events The record format. Standard library only.
core The domain types and the conversation. No files, no network, no terminal.
trace The file writer. Owns ordering, writes groups atomically.
config Settings, read strictly.
auth Sign-in and credential storage.
providers The model interface, plus anthropic and openai.
loop The thing that answers one question.
render Records in, strings out.
theme, tui Appearance, and the chat interface.
cli Wiring. Nothing imports it.

Those boundaries are an allow-list per package in .golangci.yml, running in strict mode. An import nobody explicitly permitted fails the build. Widening a list is a visible line in a diff with a reason next to it, not something that happens by accident.

Three decisions do most of the work:

  • A provider only knows how to dial, read a chunk, and hang up. Queueing, retrying, and counting are written once and shared. Adding a provider is a few hundred lines, not a copy of the machinery. (0034)
  • Things register themselves. Providers and file writers add themselves to the set that settings choose from. So the wiring layer names no implementation, and the error listing your options cannot go stale. (0028)
  • The screen is a read-only view. It renders records and nothing else. (0015)

Working on Eva

make verify

That is exactly what CI checks on every change. It splits in two: make check needs nothing but this repository, and make audit reaches the network — so its answer can change while the tree does not, which is why CI also runs it on a schedule. CI runs one thing beyond it, make rehearse, described below.

There are four entry points. make help lists every target with what it does, generated from the Makefile itself — so this page names the ones you choose between rather than repeating a list that would go stale:

Target What it does
make verify check and audit — everything CI runs
make check Everything that needs no network
make audit The checks that reach the network, so their answer can change on their own
make rehearse The whole release path without a tag: guard, snapshot, and a real install

Every tool version is pinned and run via go run, so you install nothing and your results match CI.

CI is four workflows, split by what makes each one fail:

Workflow Runs When
ci.yml fmt, build, vet, test, lint, platforms, rehearse Every change
security.yml gosec Every change
audit.yml tidy-check, mod-verify, vuln Every change, and Mondays
release.yml All three, then builds and publishes A v* tag

Only the audit has a schedule, and it is the only one that needs one: a vulnerability is published on somebody else's timetable, so its answer changes while the tree does not. Everything else is a pure function of the tree.

make check-coverage reads make check-list and fails when no workflow a commit reaches runs a declared target. Coverage is derived from the workflow files rather than listed a second time, so the three files can't drift from the Makefile. It runs in ci.yml's gate job and at a desk, because a script both can call is worth more than a step only CI could.

make rehearse is the same idea applied to the release. Nine defects on the first two releases were reachable only by pushing a tag; the rehearsal runs the guard, builds every archive, and installs from what it built — which is also what checks that the name the install script derives is the name the build wrote. Only signing still needs a tag, because keyless signing needs an OIDC token a laptop does not have.

Tests drive the real Anthropic and OpenAI code against a local server speaking the real protocol. There's no mock provider, because a mock is a second implementation that can disagree with the first and be believed. (0036)

Where to read more
docs/tutorial/first-run.md Build it, ask one question, then read that question back out of the trace.
docs/how-to/ One guide per task: providers, subscriptions, scripting, the trace, repo themes.
docs/product.md The map to every design document. Start here to find the rest.
docs/roadmap.md The plan. Nineteen stages, each with a test it can fail. Draft.
docs/decisions.md Every decision on one page, grouped by topic. Start here.
docs/adr/ The decisions in full, one file each. The filename is the decision, so ls is the index.
CONTEXT.md The glossary. One concept, one name.
AGENTS.md How to work in this repo.
docs/agents/design-rules.md The practices the code follows, and which ones a linter enforces.
docs/agents/project-structure.md Where a new package or binary goes.

Nothing in docs/adr/ is ever rewritten or deleted. When a later decision overturns an earlier one, the old file says so in its own status line and stays. Being wrong is part of the record too.

It runs in ci.yml's gate job and at a desk, because a script both can call is worth more than a step only CI could. make rehearse is the same idea applied to the release. Nine defects on the first two releases were reachable only by pushing a tag; the rehearsal runs the guard, builds every archive, and installs from what it built — which is also what checks that the name the install script derives is the name the build wrote. Only signing still needs a tag, because keyless signing needs an OIDC token a laptop does not have. Tests drive the real Anthropic and OpenAI code against a local server speaking the real protocol. There's no mock provider, because a mock is a second implementation that can disagree with the first and be believed. content_html_zh:
一个自主的、多租户的、人工智能原生的软件工厂

大多数人工智能工具都会告诉你它们做了什么。 伊娃先把它写下来。

您提出的每个问题、返回的每个答案、每次重试以及计数的每个令牌都会在发生时附加到磁盘上的文件中。 您在屏幕上看到的内容是从该文件中读回的。 如果 Eva 向您显示答案，则文件中已包含答案。 事件没有第二个版本。

这听起来是一件小事。 这是整个设计。

它看起来像什么

注意状态行中未报告的成本。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都没有返回美元数字的响应。 所以 Eva 是这么说的，而不是将代币乘以在某处查找到的价格。 您可以与法案争论的数字必须来自法案。

Note

伊娃来得早。 今天，它是一个很好的终端聊天客户端，具有非常精心构建的基础。 它可以读取您的问题并回答它。 它无法读取您的文件、运行您的测试或触摸您的 shell——目前还没有工具。

这是要去哪里

Eva 正在构建用于编码代理的控制平面。 工作以带有机器可以检查的验收标准的规格的形式到达。 多个安全带在隔离环境中具有相同的规格。 Eva 拥有的验证者决定实际通过的内容，整个比赛的得分与其他所有比赛的得分相同。

首先仔细构建基础的原因是 docs/explanation/the-ladder.md 中的梯子：从模型到公司有十级，按顺序爬上去。 每一步都会增加它下面的梯级无法完成的一件事，因此您不采取的每一步都会导致失败。

Rung 没有它什么会崩溃
Model —
工作流程 控制流在模型可以容纳之前就交给了模型
Agent 什么都不适应。 每条路径都必须提前写好
环境+验证者 没有任何东西告诉代理它是错误的，所以它永远不会收敛
马具 跑步没有界限——没有预算、没有政策、没有可以使用的工具
调度程序+规范格式 更多代理商不是工厂。 工厂需要一个队列和一个规格
软件工厂 工作一次只做一件
学习循环+经济学 无需评估，每次合并更改无需成本
意图+权威 没有人拥有已决定的一切，也没有人对此负责
自治公司 —

十九个阶段，每个阶段都有可能失败的退出测试。 其中一座已建成。 该计划是草案；发货的阶段不是。

安装

在 macOS 或 Linux 上最快的进入方式：

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/missingstudio/eva/main/scripts/install.sh | sh

它会读取您的平台，下载匹配的存档，并在安装任何内容之前根据版本发布的校验和进行检查 - 不匹配的校验和不会安装任何内容并打印两个数字。 如果您不想将 URL 通过管道传输到 shell，则可以使用此存储库中的 scripts/install.sh；阅读它，然后运行它。

使用 Go 工具链：

go install github.com/missingstudio/eva/cmd/eva@latest

自己构建

您需要 Go 1.26 或更高版本，仅此而已。

git clone git@github.com:missingstudio/eva.git
cd eva
go build -o eva ./cmd/eva

这会在当前目录中生成一个二进制文件。 如果您希望它随处可见，请将其放在您的路径中。 eva 版本说明您正在与哪个版本交谈。

您也可以直接安装最新的提交，无需发布：

go install github.com/missingstudio/eva/cmd/eva@main

Go 将 main 解析为携带提交的伪版本，因此 eva 版本仍然报告准确的内容。 它已经通过了 CI，仅此而已——期待时不时会有破碎的一天。

要在发布之前尝试修复，安装脚本需要一个通道：

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/missingstudio/eva/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --channel next

每个路径，以及如何验证下载的签名和来源，都写在 how-to/install-eva.md 中。

连接模型

Eva 与 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 进行了对话。 选择一个。

使用 API 密钥

export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
./eva

这就是整个设置。 Anthropic 是默认设置，因此无需配置。

对于 OpenAI，创建一个设置文件并命名提供程序：

./eva init                       # writes ~/.eva/config.toml
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
[provider]
name = "openai"

一根线就够了。 模型和关键变量遵循您选择的提供程序，因此您无需大声说出任何一个，即可获得 gpt-5.6-terra 读取 OPENAI_API_KEY 的信息。

通过 ChatGPT 或 Codex 订阅

如果您按月向 OpenAI 付费，则可以使用它来代替 API 密钥：

./eva login

它会打印一个 URL 和一个短代码，您在浏览器中批准它，并将凭据保存到 ~/.eva/auth.json。 然后在~/.eva/config.toml中设置模式：

[provider]
name = "openai"
auth = "subscription"

随时检查 Eva 实际会使用什么：

./eva auth status
provider: openai
auth:     subscription
store:    /Users/you/.eva/auth.json
login:    account acct_1a2b, valid until Mon, 11 Aug 2026 09:14:00 IST

重要的

auth 决定，没有什么可以超越它。 如果显示订阅，则会忽略导出的 OPENAI_API_KEY，并且 eva auth status 会告诉您这一点，而不是悄悄使用它。 大多数工具首先尝试环境，这就是人们在一个月内向错误的帐户计费而不注意的方式。 （为什么）

您的密钥永远不会写入设置文件。 Eva 从环境中读取它，或者在您登录时获取它。 它永远不会出现在历史文件、日志或发送到模型的任何内容中。

使用伊娃

聊天

不带参数和类型运行 eva。 答案一到达就源源不断地涌来。

Key 它的作用
enter Send
Shift+Enter 或 Alt+Enter 新行不发送
ctrl+c 停止正在进行的回答，保留您输入的内容
ctrl+d Quit
tab 完成斜杠命令
Shift+↑ ↓, pgup pgdn 向后滚动
ctrl+home / ctrl+end 跳到顶部/返回直播

中断是安全的。 对话保持可用，并且历史文件记录了您停止对话的情况。

斜杠命令

在行首键入 /。 这些都是在本地处理的，永远不会到达模型，因此它们不需要任何成本。

命令 它的作用
/help 列出命令
/cost 到目前为止，这次谈话的成本是多少
/clear 开始新的对话
/model 显示哪个模型正在回答
/型号 gpt-5.6-terra 切换模型，保持对话
/login 解释登录发生在聊天之外

/model 在对话中交换模型而不丢失上下文，因此下一个答案仍然知道您谈论的内容。 Eva 没有保留有效型号名称列表，因为上个月编制的列表会拒绝上周发布的型号。 如果提供商无法识别该名称，则该答案将失败并告诉您。

/clear 开始一个新对话，而不是删除当前对话中的消息。 无论哪种方式，您的旧消息仍然在历史文件中。 （为什么）

来自脚本

eva -p 回答一个问题，将其打印到标准输出，然后退出。

eva -p "explain this error" > answer.md || echo "that failed"

当答案失败时，它以非零值退出，并将原因写入 stderr。 这使得它可以安全地在管道中使用：stdout 就是答案，仅此而已。

当某事失败时

› what is this?

No response — the credential was refused
provider.auth is "api_key", so what anthropic refused is the key in
$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

两条线，都是真的。 第一个名称是用 Eva 自己的话而不是供应商的错误文档来命名故障类型。 仅当伊娃检查了有关您的机器的某些信息时，并且仅当该事实恰好留下了下一步时，第二个才会出现。 缺少登录名时会显示运行 eva login，因为这肯定是解决方法。 被拒绝的密钥表明哪个密钥被发送并停止，因为从这里来看，撤销、错误的组织和暂停的帐户看起来都是相同的。 派你去修复一些从未损坏过的东西，会让你付出每一次后来正确的暗示的代价。 （为什么）

您可以输入的所有内容

命令 它的作用
eva 打开聊天
eva -p "<问题>" 回答一次，打印到标准输出，退出
伊娃初始化 编写启动器设置文件
伊娃登录 登录订阅
eva 身份验证状态 显示 Eva 将如何进行身份验证
伊娃帮助 显示此列表

两个标志，这是故意的： --config <path> 选择一个设置文件， -p <question> 问一个问题。 其他一切都是设置，因为设置是可审查的，而标志则不然。

环境变量 这是做什么用的
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 你的人择钥匙
OPENAI_API_KEY 您的 OpenAI 密钥
EVA_配置 不同的设置文件（默认〜/.eva/config.toml）
EVA_HOME Eva 文件的不同目录（默认 ~/.eva）

设置

eva init 写入 ~/.eva/config.toml ，其中包含每个存在但被注释掉的选项，并且每个选项旁边都有一个注释，说明没有它会发生什么。 没有什么是为你选择的。 取消注释一行以更改它。

这是伊娃在没有写下来的情况下所做的事情：

model = "claude-sonnet-4-5"     # follows the provider if you leave it out

[provider]
name        = "anthropic"       # anthropic or openai
auth        = "api_key"         # api_key or subscription
api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
base_url    = ""                # a proxy, gateway, or local server
max_tokens  = 0                 # 0 lets the provider decide

[trace]
path = "~/.eva/trace.jsonl"     # where the history goes
kind = "jsonl"                  # which writer keeps it

[identity]
tenant     = "local"
actor      = "local"
actor_kind = "human"            # human, agent, or system

颜色、字形、间距和键绑定位于 [theme] 和 [keymap.bind] 下，起始文件也列出了这些。 不设置任何一个，Eva 看起来就和任何一个可配置之前一样。 颜色遵循终端的背景及其可显示的内容，因此无需告知即可适应。

设置从四个位置读取，每个位置都会覆盖之前的位置：内置默认值、您的文件、项目文件，然后是 --config。 伊娃和他们都相处得很好。

拼写错误是一个错误，而不是耸肩。 写 modl =“...” 伊娃拒绝启动并说出钥匙的名称。 默默地忽略您所写内容的设置文件比无法加载的设置文件更糟糕。

项目设置

仓库可以携带 .eva/config.toml，无论你在哪里，都可以找到它。 方便分享团队的外观：

[theme.colors]
person = "#7AA6DC"

[theme.symbols]
prompt = "› "

[keymap.bind]
follow = ["ctrl+g"]

警告

回购可以改变 Eva 的外观，但不能改变它的功能。 您从互联网上克隆一个存储库，Eva 在您提出第一个问题之前读取该文件，并在保存您的 API 密钥的进程中读取该文件。 因此，它可能设置的列表是一个简短的允许列表：外观和键绑定。 它无法选择模型提供者、将流量指向另一台服务器、重命名从中读取密钥的变量或移动历史文件。 该文件中的任何其他内容都会按名称拒绝。 （为什么）

词汇表

Eva 对命名非常严格，因为同一个概念在三个名称下会导致代码库的腐烂。 其中五个出现在文档和代码中：

Word 简单的英语
会议 一次谈话。 幸免于难。 恢复和倒带将起作用。
Run 一个问题及其答案。 一次谈话有很多。
Turn 模型的一次往返。 一旦工具存在，一次运行可能需要多次。
Trace 历史档案。 所发生事件的唯一真相来源。
提供者 一个界面背后的模型：Anthropic、OpenAI，无论接下来会发生什么。

完整列表是 CONTEXT.md，包括已尝试过和已停用的单词。

伊娃是如何建造的

一去模块。 数据以一种方式流动，编译器强制执行。

   you type                                     you read
      │                                            ▲
      ▼                                            │
   ┌──────┐    ┌──────┐    ┌───────────┐        ┌────────┐
   │ tui  │───▶│ loop │───▶│ providers │        │ render │
   └──────┘    └──┬───┘    └───────────┘        └───▲────┘
                  │                                 │
                  ▼          committed first        │
              ┌───────┐  ───────────────────────────┘
              │ trace │      then shown
              └───────┘

重要的部分是底部。 没有首先浏览该文件的任何内容都不会到达您的屏幕。 渲染层在物理上无法与模型、对话或历史文件对话。 它获取记录并返回字符串，这就是它允许导入的全部内容。

包裹 那里住着什么
事件 记录格式。 仅标准库。
core 域类型和对话。 没有文件，没有网络，没有终端。
trace 文件编写者。 拥有排序功能，自动写入组。
配置 设置，严格阅读。
auth 登录和凭据存储。
提供者 模型界面，加上anthropic和openai。
loop 回答一个问题的东西。
使成为 录音输入，字符串输出。
主题, 推 外观，以及聊天界面。
cli 接线。 没有任何东西导入它。

这些边界是 .golangci.yml 中每个包的允许列表，以严格模式运行。 无人明确允许的导入会使构建失败。 扩大列表是差异中的一条可见线，旁边有一个原因，而不是偶然发生的事情。

三个决定完成了大部分工作：

  • 提供者只知道如何拨号、读取数据块和挂断。 排队、重试和计数都是一次性编写并共享的。 添加提供者只需几百行，而不是机器的副本。 (0034)
  • 事物会自行注册。 提供者和文件编写者将自己添加到设置选择的集合中。 因此，布线层没有指定任何实现，并且列出您的选项的错误不会过时。 (0028)
  • 该屏幕是只读视图。 它只渲染记录，仅此而已。 (0015)

为伊娃工作

make verify

这正是 CI 检查每个更改的内容。 它分为两部分：make check 除了这个存储库之外不需要任何东西，并且 makeaudit 到达网络 - 因此它的答案可以改变，而树则不会，这就是 CI 也按计划运行它的原因。 CI 还运行一件事，进行排练，如下所述。

有四个入口点。 make help 列出了从 Makefile 本身生成的每个目标及其功能 - 因此此页面会命名您选择的目标，而不是重复会过时的列表：

目标 它的作用
进行验证 检查和审计——CI 运行的一切
进行检查 一切不需要网络的东西
进行审核 到达网络的检查，因此他们的答案可以自行改变
排练 无标签的整个发布路径：防护、快照和真实安装

每个工具版本都固定并通过 go run 运行，因此您无需安装任何内容，并且结果与 CI 匹配。

CI 是四个工作流程，按每个工作流程失败的原因进行划分：

工作流程 Runs When
ci.yml fmt、构建、审查、测试、lint、平台、排练 每一次改变
安全.yml gosec 每一次改变
审计.yml 整洁检查、修改验证、漏洞 每次变化和星期一

只有审计有时间表，而且它是唯一需要时间表的审计：漏洞是在其他人的时间表上发布的，因此它的答案会改变，而树不会改变。 其他一切都是树的纯粹函数。
